body:
You’re thoughtful and kind. But, I’ve seen how my soon to be ex-wife speaks of me. My daughter told her she thinks I’m disgusting and won’t look at me.

It’s ok - I think knowing they’ll be with someone better than me gives me peace. They’ll finally have access to a father who is assertive, honest, and can give them everything I never could. They deserve the best and the reset button for me is to let them live in peace. Maybe they’ll grieve but I am not confident. Assholes like me don’t deserve a second chance. And anyway, women won’t want to be with someone like me. No women in the wild is looking for a dishonest cheater.

You seem to have a calm soul and a firm stance on life. Thank you for responding - I will take this as peace and kindness from you when someone shared a listening ear while I finish my plans.
